Essere una forza per il bene e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre

In qualità di Brand Experience Specialist presso Nestlé Suisse S.A., la vostra missione è di ringiovanire THOMY e approfondire la lealtà dei consumatori offrendo esperienze di brand integrate che rafforzano la connessione emotiva e spingono la crescita sostenibile. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con marketing, vendite, comunicazioni, team di food-service, agenzie e partner di sponsorizzazione. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fare la differenza in scala.

Come farete un impatto come specialista di Brand Experience

• Trasformando intuizioni di consumatori, culturali e di categoria in esperienze di marca convincenti che crescono la rilevanza del marchio e l'impatto commerciale.

• Definire una strategia di attivazione omnicanale che crea un'esperienza di THOMY senza soluzione di continuità attraverso il canale OOH / convenienza.

• Attivare una rete esterna per costruire partnership di sponsorizzazione locali di alto valore che espandono la visibilità, rafforzino il significato del marchio e sbloccano la crescita sostenibile.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire le attivazioni del marchio, eventi di marketing dal vivo e le esperienze del marchio che convertono la partecipazione in una duratura fedeltà, impegno e advocacy.

• Fornire piani di amplificazione integrati che collegano ogni attivazione alle priorità del marchio e risultati aziendali misurabili.

• Guidare l'esecuzione eccellente attraverso una collaborazione chiara, allocazione intelligente delle risorse e apprendimento continuo dai risultati.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portando una forte esperienza nel marketing del marchio, nell'attivazione dei consumatori, nelle comunicazioni o nel marketing degli shopper, agendo come ambasciatore appassionato di THOMY sia internamente che esternamente.

• Applicando conoscenze di mercato Out-of-Home per fornire attivazioni omnichannel integrate che rafforzano la visibilità del marchio e i risultati aziendali di guida in tutta la regione, supportato dalla flessibilità di viaggiare regolarmente e dalla valida licenza del conducente.

• Utilizzando le conoscenze dei consumatori, le metriche delle prestazioni e le competenze di gestione del bilancio per ottimizzare l'esecuzione, misurare l'efficacia e massimizzare il ritorno sugli investimenti.

• Collaborare efficacemente con le agenzie, i partner esterni e i team interfunzionali, mentre i progetti principali da breve a successo implementazione.

• Comunicare fluentemente in tedesco / tedesco svizzero e inglese.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Ci impegniamo a un processo di assunzione interno equo e trasparente e assicuriamo che tutte le applicazioni siano trattate con riservatezza.

La tua applicazione in genere includerà una recensione iniziale, conversazioni con Talent Acquisition e il team di assunzione, seguita da una discussione finale.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronti a crescere con noi?

Applicare ora e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre.

• Führen Sie eine hervorragende Ausführung durch klare Zusammenarbeit, intelligente Ressourcenzuweisung und kontinuierliches Lernen aus den Ergebnissen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Wir bringen starkes Know-how in den Bereichen Markenmarketing, Verbraucheraktivierung, Kommunikation oder Käufermarketing mit und sind gleichzeitig als leidenschaftlicher Botschafter für THOMY sowohl intern als auch extern tätig.

• Anwendung von Out-of-Home-Marktwissen, um integrierte Omnichannel-Aktivierungen zu liefern, die die Markensichtbarkeit stärken und die Geschäftsergebnisse in der Region steigern, unterstützt durch die Flexibilität, regelmäßig zu reisen und einen gültigen Führerschein.

• Effektive Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen, externen Partnern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams, während Projekte von der kurzen bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung geleitet werden.

• Fließend kommunizieren in Schweizer Deutsch/Deutsch und Englisch.

• Demonstration von Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierlichem Lernen.

As a Key Account Manager at Nestlé Purina PetCare Switzerland, your mission is to own and steer the commercial performance of strategic retail customers in Switzerland, delivering sustainable growth, profitability, market share and excellent execution. Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expertise en stratégie de marque et une compréhension claire de la façon d'accroître la performance de la marque, les capitaux propres et la valeur du portefeuille.

• Appliquer les connaissances des consommateurs et du marché pour façonner des stratégies efficaces d'innovation, de rénovation et d'activation.

• Utiliser l'acuité commerciale et financière pour gérer les performances de la marque, optimiser les investissements et traduire les priorités en résultats.

• Collaborer efficacement entre les fonctions et avec les partenaires externes tout en dirigeant, développant et stimulant une équipe hautement performante.

• Communiquez avec les compétences de travail en anglais et en allemand ou en anglais et en français.

• Démontrer courage, collaboration, rapidité et apprentissage continu.

Chez Nestlé, nous nous intéressons à notre peuple.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime basée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte cotisation de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue vidéo avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Prêt à grandir avec nous ?

jobs.title: SPX Data & AI Innovation Intern
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months

Start date: January / February 2027
Deadline for applications: 14 October 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As an SPX Data & AI Innovation Intern at Nestlé Research & Development, your mission is to support building the future SPX knowledge ecosystem through dashboards, connected data and Artificial Intelligence. You will support the Sensory & Product Experience (SPX) Digital & AI roadmap by improving data accessibility, developing innovative digital solutions, and accelerating insight generation across product innovation projects.

Working closely with Sensory & Product Experience experts, data engineers and innovation teams, you will help transform complex datasets into actionable knowledge while gaining hands-on experience at the intersection of sensory science, consumer understanding, data science, and AI.

How you’ll make an impact as a SPX Data & AI Innovation Intern

• Develop and enhance SPX Dashboards to improve visibility, accessibility, and use of sensory and consumer data across teams.

• Connect and explore multiple data sources, including Methods of Preparation (MOP), Key Sensory Attributes (KSA), Sensory Profiles, Claims, Global Sensory Mapping (GSM), Consumer Research, and Market Insights.

• Create impactful data visualizations and translate complex data into meaningful business insights.

• Support the development of AI-powered solutions and knowledge systems that improve information retrieval and insight generation.

• Collaborate with sensory scientists, consumer insight experts, and digital specialists to accelerate product renovation and innovation.

What will make you successful

• Bachelor’s or Master’s student, or recent graduate, in Data Science, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Food Science, or a related field

• Strong interest in data, digital technologies, consumer experience, sensory and product innovation

• Comfortable working with data and translating complex information into meaningful insights

• Academic or previous work experience with Power BI or similar visualization tools, and Version Control Sytems (like Github)

• Programming skills in Python or R

• Experience with AI-enabled tools, knowledge systems, or data exploration platforms is an advantage

• Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, collaboration, and communication skills

• Fluency in English (written and spoken)

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

Essere una forza per il bene e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario

Come Interno di innovazione SPX Data & AI presso Nestlé Research & Development, la vostra missione è di supportare la costruzione del futuro ecosistema di conoscenza SPX attraverso dashboard, dati connessi e intelligenza artificiale. Sosterrai la roadmap Sensory & Product Experience (SPX) Digital & AI migliorando l'accessibilità dei dati, sviluppando soluzioni digitali innovative e accelerando la generazione di informazioni sui progetti di innovazione dei prodotti.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con esperti Sensory & Product Experience, ingegneri di dati e team di innovazione, vi aiuterà a trasformare complessi set di dati in conoscenze attuabili, acquisendo esperienza pratica all'incrocio tra scienza sensoriale, comprensione dei consumatori, scienza dei dati e AI.

Come farete un impatto come Interno di innovazione SPX Data & AI

• Sviluppare e migliorare SPX Dashboards per migliorare la visibilità, l'accessibilità e l'uso di dati sensoriali e di consumo in team.

• Collegare ed esplorare più fonti di dati, tra cui i metodi di preparazione (MOP), gli attributi sensoriali chiave (KSA), i profili sensoriali, i reclami, la mappatura globale dei sensori (GSM), la ricerca dei consumatori e le prospettive di mercato.

• Creare visualizzazioni di dati di impatto e tradurre dati complessi in insight aziendali significativi.

• Sostenere lo sviluppo di soluzioni e sistemi di conoscenza basati su AI che migliorano il recupero delle informazioni e la generazione di informazioni.

• Collabora con gli scienziati sensoriali, gli esperti di informazioni sui consumatori e gli specialisti digitali per accelerare la ristrutturazione e l'innovazione dei prodotti.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Corso di laurea o studente del Master, o recentemente laureato, in Scienza dei dati, Statistica, Intelligenza artificiale, Scienza informatica, Scienza alimentare, o un campo relativo

• Forte interesse per i dati, le tecnologie digitali, l'esperienza dei consumatori, l'innovazione sensoriale e dei prodotti

• Lavorare con i dati e tradurre informazioni complesse in insight significativi

• Esperienza accademica o precedente di lavoro con Power BI o simili strumenti di visualizzazione, e Version Control Sytems (come Github)

• Capacità di programmazione in Python o R

• L'esperienza con strumenti, sistemi di conoscenza o piattaforme di esplorazione dei dati abilitati all'IA è un vantaggio

• Forte capacità di pensiero analitico, curiosità, collaborazione e comunicazione

• Fluenza in inglese (scritto e parlato)

• Dimostrando coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso.

A Nestlé, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Pronto a iniziare il tuo viaggio di carriera con noi?

Applicare ora e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort: Orbe, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid
Vertragsart/Dauer: Praktikum – 6 Monate

Startdatum: Januar / Februar 2027
Bewerbungsfrist: 14. Oktober 2026

Seien Sie eine Kraft für das Gute und verwandeln Sie Ihr Potenzial in etwas Außergewöhnliches

Als SPX Data & AI Innovation Intern bei Nestlé Research & Development ist es Ihre Mission, den Aufbau des zukünftigen SPX-Wissens-Ökosystems durch Dashboards, vernetzte Daten und künstliche Intelligenz zu unterstützen. Sie unterstützen die Digital & AI Roadmap von Sensory & Product Experience (SPX), indem Sie die Zugänglichkeit von Daten verbessern, innovative digitale Lösungen entwickeln und die Generierung von Erkenntnissen in Produktinnovationsprojekten beschleunigen.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Experten für Sensory & Product Experience, Dateningenieuren und Innovationsteams helfen Sie dabei, komplexe Datensätze in umsetzbares Wissen zu verwandeln und gleichzeitig praktische Erfahrungen an der Schnittstelle von Sensorik, Verbraucherverständnis, Datenwissenschaft und KI zu sammeln.

Wie Sie als SPX Data & AI Innovation Intern etwas bewirken können

• Entwickeln und verbessern Sie SPX Dashboards, um die Sichtbarkeit, Zugänglichkeit und Nutzung von Sensorik- und Verbraucherdaten teamübergreifend zu verbessern.

• Verbinden und erkunden Sie mehrere Datenquellen, einschließlich Methoden der Vorbereitung (MOP), Key Sensory Attributes (KSA), Sensory Profiles, Claims, Global Sensory Mapping (GSM), Consumer Research und Market Insights.

• Erstellen Sie wirkungsvolle Datenvisualisierungen und übersetzen Sie komplexe Daten in sinnvolle Business Insights.

• Unterstützung der Entwicklung von KI-gestützten Lösungen und Wissenssystemen, die den Informationsabruf und die Generierung von Erkenntnissen verbessern.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Sensorikern, Experten für Verbraucherinformationen und digitalen Spezialisten zusammen, um die Produktrenovierung und -innovation zu beschleunigen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bachelor- oder Master-Student oder neuer Absolvent, in Data Science, Statistik, Künstliche Intelligenz, Informatik, Food Science oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Starkes Interesse an Daten, digitalen Technologien, Verbrauchererfahrung, sensorischen und Produktinnovationen

• Komfortables Arbeiten mit Daten und Umsetzung komplexer Informationen in sinnvolle Erkenntnisse

• Akademische oder frühere Arbeitserfahrung mit Power BI oder ähnlichen Visualisierungstools und Versionskontrollsystemen (wie Github)

• Programmierkenntnisse in Python oder R

• Erfahrung mit KI-fähigen Tools, Wissenssystemen oder Datenerkundungsplattformen ist von Vorteil

• Starkes analytisches Denken, Neugier, Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Fließend in Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen)

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen.

Bei Nestlé stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für bürobasierte Rollen)

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Karriere mit uns zu beginnen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und verwandeln Sie Ihr Potenzial in etwas Außergewöhnliches.

Contract type: Permanent

Programme: 4-year development programme with 5–6-month international factory assignments across Nestlé’s global Operations network

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Performance Acceleration Senior Analyst at Nestlé Operations, you will join a unique 4-year development programme, completing international assignments of 5-6 months in Nestlé factories around the world. Your mission will be to accelerate operational performance and drive sustainable improvements across our global manufacturing network. You'll make a difference by collaborating closely with local factory teams, R&D experts, and corporate stakeholders.

With extensive international travel and hands-on exposure to complex manufacturing operations, this is your opportunity to grow your career, work across diverse cultures and production environments, and build a strong network within Nestlé's global Operations community.

How you’ll make an impact as a Performance Acceleration Senior Analyst

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance, productivity, and competitiveness across factories worldwide.

• Leading operational optimization and digital transformation projects that deliver measurable and sustainable results.

• Collaborating with factory leadership teams, technical experts, and global stakeholders to accelerate implementation and value creation.

• Coaching teams and supporting capability building to embed best practices and sustain long-term improvements.

• Managing cross-functional projects while leveraging Nestlé's global network to share knowledge, benchmark performance, and accelerate innovation.

• Strengthening operational excellence capabilities by promoting manufacturing standards and continuous learning across markets.

What will make you successful

• Bringing experience in a factory environment, such as production, quality, engineering, or related manufacturing functions. Previous line management experience is a plus.

• Applying strong project leadership and problem-solving skills to deliver meaningful business improvements.

• Using coaching and influencing capabilities to engage, develop, and support diverse teams.

• Embracing a highly international role that combines extensive travel, long-term factory assignments, and collaboration with diverse teams across different cultures and markets.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional language skills are an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland, with regular travel to Orbe and other Nestlé R&D sites
Work model: Full-time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Closing Date for Applications: 15th September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Patent Counsel in Digital & AI, your mission is to enable and protect Nestlé’s digital, AI-driven and electronics-centric innovations through pragmatic legal services and business-driven IP protection. You will act as the go-to Legal R&D partner for Digital & AI topics across the Nestlé R&D ecosystem, collaborating closely with R&D teams, Patent Counsels, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts. This is your opportunity to shape and grow the IP strategy for one of Nestlé’s most strategic innovation frontiers.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Counsel – Digital & AI

• Develop and deliver the IP strategy for digital, AI and electronics-driven innovations, in close partnership with R&D teams, the patent team, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts.

• Lead business-driven patent filing and prosecution, Freedom-to-Operate assessments, oppositions of third-party patents and defense against third-party oppositions.

• Manage your patent portfolio with strong business alignment and rigorous cost management.

• Advise on IP matters in R&D collaborations, including Digital & AI partnerships, licensing and joint developments.

• Support Coffee & Systems and other categories on connected systems, digital platforms and AI-based innovations, in collaboration with category Patent Counsels.

• Partner with Nestlé Research, the Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional and other R&D centers to protect digital and AI innovations across categories.

• Promote passion for IP through awareness sessions, training and communication, while contributing to the awareness and enforcement of Nestlé patents in R&D and in the markets.

What will make you successful

• Fully qualified patent attorney, European Patent Attorney (EQE) and/or national qualification in a major jurisdiction such as the USA, with a background in Electronics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI or a related engineering discipline.

• Proven experience in digital, AI and/or electronics-related IP projects, ideally including software-implemented inventions, AI/ML, connected devices and computer-implemented business methods.

• More than 3 years of post-qualification experience with patent drafting, prosecution and Freedom-to-Operate assessments in the digital, electronics or AI space.

• Experience developing business-driven IP strategies across multiple jurisdictions, with a solid understanding of software and AI patenting specificities such as EPO, USPTO and CNIPA.

• Service-oriented, pragmatic, rigorous, hands-on and collaborative, with the ability to engage confidently with R&D partners, category teams and stakeholders at different levels of seniority.

• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way, across different brands, businesses, functions, and regions.

• Flexible working arrangements that facilitate creativity and collaboration.

• A culture of respect, with diversity, equity, and inclusion at its core.

• A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop, and grow.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives, and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference.

Potrai fungere da partner R&D legale per temi Digital & AI in tutto l'ecosistema Nestlé R&D, collaborando a stretto contatto con i team R&D, Patent Counsels, R&D Counsels e IP Analysts. Questa è la vostra opportunità di plasmare e far crescere la strategia IP per una delle frontiere più strategiche dell’innovazione di Nestlé.

Come farai un impatto come consulente brevetti – Digital & AI

• Sviluppare e fornire la strategia IP per le innovazioni digitali, AI e electronics-driven, in stretta collaborazione con i team R&D, il team di brevetti, i consulenti R&D e gli analisti IP.

• Leader business-driven brevettt deposito e persecuzione, valutazioni Freedom-to-Operate, opposizione di brevetti di terze parti e difesa contro opposizioni di terzi.

• Gestisci il tuo portafoglio brevetti con un forte allineamento aziendale e una rigorosa gestione dei costi.

• Consigli sulle questioni IP nelle collaborazioni R&D, tra cui le partnership Digital & AI, le licenze e gli sviluppi congiunti.

• Support Coffee & Systems e altre categorie su sistemi collegati, piattaforme digitali e innovazioni basate su AI, in collaborazione con i consulenti di brevetti di categoria.

• Partner di Nestlé Research, Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional e altri centri R&D per proteggere le innovazioni digitali e AI in tutte le categorie.

• Promuovere la passione per l'IP attraverso sessioni di sensibilizzazione, formazione e comunicazione, contribuendo alla consapevolezza e all'applicazione dei brevetti Nestlé in R&D e nei mercati.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Procuratore di brevetti completamente qualificato, Avvocato europeo dei brevetti (EQE) e / o qualifica nazionale in una giurisdizione principale come gli Stati Uniti, con un background in Elettronica, Scienza informatica, Ingegneria del software, Scienza dei dati, AI o una disciplina di ingegneria correlata.

• Esperienza dimostrata nei progetti IP digitali, AI e/o relativi all'elettronica, idealmente compresi invenzioni implementate dal software, AI/ML, dispositivi connessi e metodi di business implementati dal computer.

• Più di 3 anni di esperienza post-qualificazione con la redazione di brevetti, la prosecuzione e le valutazioni Freedom-to-Operate nello spazio digitale, elettronico o AI.

• Sperimenta lo sviluppo di strategie IP business-driven in più giurisdizioni, con una solida comprensione del software e delle specifiche di brevetti AI come EPO, USPTO e CNIPA.

• Service-oriented, pragmatico, rigoroso, pratico e collaborativo, con la capacità di impegnarsi con fiducia con partner R&D, team di categoria e stakeholder a diversi livelli di seniority.

• Fluente in inglese; francese è un plus.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

A Nestlé, ci preoccupiamo della nostra gente

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Eccitanti opportunità per sviluppare la tua carriera il tuo modo, attraverso diversi marchi, aziende, funzioni e regioni.

• Disposizioni di lavoro flessibili che facilitano la creatività e la collaborazione.

• Una cultura del rispetto, con diversità, equità e inclusione nel suo nucleo.

• Un ambiente dinamico internazionale che ti consente di imparare, sviluppare e crescere.

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Vous jouerez le rôle de partenaire juridique en R-D pour les sujets liés au numérique et à l'IA dans tout l'écosystème de R-D de Nestlé, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes de R-D, les conseils en brevets, les conseils en R-D et les analystes en PI. C'est l'occasion de façonner et de développer la stratégie de propriété intellectuelle pour l'une des frontières les plus stratégiques de l'innovation de Nestlé.

Comment vous aurez un impact en tant que conseiller en brevets – Digital & AI

jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based / Full time
Contract type / duration: Fixed-term contract (2 years)

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to lead bioprocessing activities that bridge lab-scale discovery and industrial manufacturing through robust fermentation and downstream processing solutions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with pilot plant teams, scientists, engineers, quality and safety specialists, technical experts and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (DSP)

• Leading pilot-scale bioprocess trials that help transform promising research into scalable manufacturing solutions.

• Driving fermentation process development by optimizing media, feeding strategies and key operating parameters for reliable performance.

• Developing downstream processing approaches that improve yield, recovery and product quality.

• Building process understanding through data analysis, automation insights and digital tools that support optimization and reproducibility.

• Contributing to safe, compliant and high-quality pilot plant operations through risk assessment, documentation and continuous improvement.

• Shaping the development of new biotech pilot plant capabilities by translating process needs into practical equipment and facility solutions.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in fermentation, bioprocessing and pilot or industrial-scale operations.

• Applying scale-up, technology transfer and industrialization knowledge to make processes robust and ready for implementation.

• Using analytical thinking, process data and automation tools to troubleshoot, optimize and improve reproducibility.

• Collaborating across research, engineering, operations, quality and safety teams with ownership and a hands-on mindset.

• Communicating confidently and delivering presentations in French or English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

• Sviluppo del processo di fermentazione di guida ottimizzando i media, le strategie di alimentazione e i parametri di funzionamento chiave per prestazioni affidabili.

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) bei Nestlé Research ist es Ihre Mission, Bioprozessing-Aktivitäten zu leiten, die die Entdeckung im Labormaßstab und die industrielle Fertigung durch robuste Fermentations- und Downstream-Verarbeitungslösungen verbinden. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Pilotanlagenteams, Wissenschaftlern, Ingenieuren, Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsspezialisten, technischen Experten und externen Partnern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (DSP) etwas bewirken

• Führende Bioprozessversuche im Pilotmaßstab, die dazu beitragen, vielversprechende Forschung in skalierbare Fertigungslösungen umzuwandeln.

• Förderung der Entwicklung von Fermentationsprozessen durch Optimierung von Medien, Fütterungsstrategien und wichtigen Betriebsparametern für eine zuverlässige Leistung.

• Entwicklung nachgelagerter Verarbeitungsansätze, die den Ertrag, die Rückgewinnung und die Produktqualität verbessern.

• Aufbau eines Prozessverständnisses durch Datenanalyse, Automatisierungseinsichten und digitale Tools, die die Optimierung und Reproduzierbarkeit unterstützen.

• Beitrag zu einem sicheren, konformen und qualitativ hochwertigen Pilotbetrieb durch Risikobewertung, Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

• Gestaltung der Entwicklung neuer Biotech-Pilotanlagen durch Umsetzung der Prozessanforderungen in praktische Ausrüstungs- und Anlagenlösungen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Mitbringen starker Expertise in den Bereichen Fermentation, Bioverarbeitung und Pilot- oder Industriebetrieb.

• Anwendung von Scale-up, Technologietransfer und Industrialisierungswissen, um Prozesse robust und bereit für die Implementierung zu machen.

• Mit analytischem Denken, Prozessdaten und Automatisierungstools zur Fehlersuche, Optimierung und Verbesserung der Reproduzierbarkeit.

• Zusammenarbeit zwischen Forschungs-, Ingenieur-, Betriebs-, Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsteams mit Eigenverantwortung und einer praktischen Denkweise.

• Vertrauensvoll kommunizieren und Präsentationen in Französisch oder Englisch halten.

• Bringt Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise.

Bei Nestlé Research stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun.

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit für #BreakthroughTogether?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

jobs.description:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Limited contract until 31.12.2027

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As an Associate Specialist Functional Microbiome at Nestlé Research, your mission is to advance research on microbial metabolites and translate functional microbiome science into meaningful business applications. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, technicians, research assistants, innovation partners and external experts across microbiome, metabolomics, immunology and related fields. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist Functional Microbiome

• Developing research that deepens understanding of microbial metabolites and their role in microbiome-host interactions.

• Translating scientific insights into nutrition, health and petcare applications with business relevance.

• Strengthening scientific approaches that move microbiome research from correlations toward causal understanding.

• Building cross-functional collaboration with internal research teams, technical experts and innovation partners.

• Expanding external scientific networks to identify emerging methods, partners and breakthrough opportunities.

• Sharing high-quality scientific outputs through publications, presentations and clear communication with key stakeholders.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD and recognized scientific expertise in biochemistry, microbiology or metabolism, with a strong focus on microbial metabolites in microbiome-host interactions.

• Applying systems biology, metabolomics and functional microbiome knowledge to generate actionable research insights.

• Using project leadership, stakeholder management and results focus to deliver high-quality research outcomes.

• Collaborating proactively across scientific disciplines while communicating complex ideas with clarity and influence.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

While we already have a strong succession plan for this role, all internal candidates whose skills most closely align with the role’s requirements will be considered. Please discuss your application with your HR Business Partner and line manager before applying.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As Machine Quality Senior Specialist at Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee & Beverages , your mission is to build trust and deliver outstanding consumer experiences by embedding food safety, compliance and quality into beverage systems of both Nespresso and Nestlé Dolce Gusto from the earliest design stages. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with project managers, category teams, factories, regulatory and legal partners, consumer services and suppliers. This is your opportunity to drive cutting-edge innovation, strengthen your expertise and deliver meaningful results to create unique consumer experiences at global scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Machine Quality Senior Specialist

• Safeguarding food safety, regulatory compliance and consumer expectations throughout beverage-system development.

• Embedding quality by design across new products, packaging, machines and production lines to improve right-first-time delivery.

• Driving robust validation plans, quality requirements and process capability from ideation through technical approval and launch.

• Anticipating quality risks through root-cause analysis, risk assessment and failure mode analysis, enabling pragmatic decisions.

• Resolving quality issues with factories and consumer service teams and ensuring corrective actions strengthen future developments.

• Building quality capability by coaching colleagues, sharing knowledge across sites and turning project lessons into continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong knowledge of quality systems, food safety, good manufacturing practices, product development and manufacturing.

• Applying root-cause analysis, risk analysis and failure mode analysis to complex design and production challenges.

• Using project management skills to align priorities, manage several developments and deliver practical solutions.

• Collaborating assertively and transparently, influencing decisions while balancing quality requirements with business realities.

• Demonstrating agility and adaptability while navigating complexity, shifting priorities and evolving project needs.

• Communicating fluently and effectively in English across all levels of the organization; proficiency in additional languages is an advantage.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your growth and wellbeing at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process
We are committed to a fair and transparent internal hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Questa è la vostra occasione per guidare l'innovazione all'avanguardia, rafforzare la vostra esperienza e fornire risultati significativi per creare esperienze di consumo uniche a livello globale.

Come farete un impatto come specialista di qualità della macchina

• Salvaguardare la sicurezza alimentare, la conformità normativa e le aspettative dei consumatori in tutto lo sviluppo del sistema delle bevande.

• Integrare la qualità attraverso la progettazione di nuovi prodotti, imballaggi, macchine e linee di produzione per migliorare la consegna in tempo reale.

• Guidare piani di validazione robusti, requisiti di qualità e capacità di processo dall'ideazione attraverso approvazione tecnica e lancio.

• Anticipazione dei rischi di qualità attraverso analisi, valutazione del rischio e analisi della modalità di fallimento, consentendo decisioni pragmatiche.

• Risolvere i problemi di qualità con le fabbriche e i team di servizi di consumo e garantire azioni correttive rafforzare gli sviluppi futuri.

• Capacità di costruzione di qualità allenando i colleghi, condividere le conoscenze sui siti e trasformare le lezioni di progetto in miglioramento continuo.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte conoscenza di sistemi di qualità, sicurezza alimentare, buone pratiche di produzione, sviluppo del prodotto e produzione.

• Applicando analisi, analisi dei rischi e analisi delle modalità di guasto a complesse sfide di progettazione e produzione.

• Utilizzando le competenze di project management per allineare le priorità, gestire diversi sviluppi e fornire soluzioni pratiche.

• Collaborando in modo assertivo e trasparente, influenzando le decisioni, bilanciando i requisiti di qualità con le realtà aziendali.

• Dimostrare agilità e adattabilità durante la navigazione della complessità, spostando le priorità e le esigenze di progetto in evoluzione.

• Comunicare fluentemente ed efficacemente in inglese su tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione; la competenza in lingue aggiuntive è un vantaggio.

A Nestlé, ci preoccupiamo della nostra gente

Offriamo un pacchetto di vantaggi competitivo e ben arrotondato progettato per sostenere la vostra crescita e benessere sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione
Ci impegniamo a un processo di assunzione interno equo e trasparente e assicuriamo che tutte le applicazioni siano trattate con riservatezza.

La tua applicazione in genere includerà una recensione iniziale, conversazioni con Talent Acquisition e il team di assunzione, seguita da una discussione finale.

En tant que spécialiste principal de la qualité des machines au Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee & Beverages , votre mission est de bâtir la confiance et de fournir des expériences de consommateurs exceptionnelles en intégrant la sécurité alimentaire, la conformité et la qualité dans les systèmes de boissons de Nespresso et Nestlé Dolce Gusto dès les premières étapes de conception. Vous ferez la différence en collaborant étroitement avec les gestionnaires de projets, les équipes de catégorie, les usines, les partenaires réglementaires et juridiques, les services aux consommateurs et les fournisseurs. C'est l'occasion de stimuler l'innovation de pointe, de renforcer votre expertise et de produire des résultats significatifs pour créer des expériences uniques des consommateurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste senior de la qualité de la machine

• Protéger la salubrité des aliments, la conformité à la réglementation et les attentes des consommateurs tout au long du développement du système de boissons.

• Intégrer la qualité par conception à de nouveaux produits, emballages, machines et lignes de production afin d'améliorer la bonne livraison.

• Conduire des plans de validation robustes, des exigences de qualité et des capacités de processus depuis l'idée jusqu'à l'approbation technique et au lancement.

• Anticiper les risques de qualité par l'analyse des causes profondes, l'évaluation des risques et l'analyse du mode d'échec, ce qui permet des décisions pragmatiques.

• Résoudre les problèmes de qualité avec les usines et les équipes de service aux consommateurs et veiller à ce que des mesures correctives renforcent les développements futurs.

• Renforcer la capacité de qualité en formant des collègues, en partageant les connaissances entre les sites et en transformant les leçons du projet en amélioration continue.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide connaissance des systèmes de qualité, de la salubrité des aliments, des bonnes pratiques de fabrication, du développement de produits et de la fabrication.

• Appliquer l'analyse des causes profondes, l'analyse des risques et l'analyse du mode de défaillance à des défis complexes de conception et de production.

• Utiliser les compétences en gestion de projet pour aligner les priorités, gérer plusieurs développements et fournir des solutions pratiques.

• Collaborer avec assurance et transparence, influencer les décisions tout en conciliant les exigences de qualité avec les réalités commerciales.

• Démontrer l'agilité et l'adaptabilité tout en naviguant dans la complexité, en changeant les priorités et en évoluant les besoins des projets.

• Communiquer couramment et efficacement en anglais à tous les niveaux de l'organisation; maîtriser d'autres langues est un avantage.

Chez Nestlé, nous nous soucions de notre peuple

Nous offrons un package d'avantages compétitif et équilibré conçu pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime basée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte cotisation de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche
Nous nous engageons à mettre en place un processus d'embauche interne équitable et transparent et nous nous assurons que toutes les demandes sont traitées de façon confidentielle.

Votre demande comprendra généralement un examen initial, des conversations avec Talent Acquisition et l'équipe d'embauche, suivies d'une discussion finale.

Prêt à grandir avec nous ?

Appliquer maintenant et grandir à travers des expériences qui vous poussent plus loin.

jobs.title: Polymechaniker:in EFZ
jobs.description:
Arbeitsort: Konolfingen, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort
Vertragsart / Dauer: Unbefristet

Be a force for good and help nurture a healthier generation

Als Polymechaniker:in EFZ bei Nestlé Nutrition & Health ist es deine Mission, die mechanischen Anlagen und die Infrastruktur an unserem Forschungs- und Entwicklungszentrum in Konolfingen zu warten und zu verbessern. Du bewirkst etwas, indem du eng mit Kolleg:innen aus dem Engineering, technischen Teams und Produktionspartnern zusammenarbeitest. Dies ist deine Gelegenheit, dein Fachwissen auszubauen und bedeutungsvolle Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die durch Ernährungsinnovationen weltweit zur Verbesserung des Lebens beitragen.

So bewirkst du als Polymechaniker:in EFZ etwas

• Warten mechanischer Anlagen und der Infrastruktur zur Unterstützung eines sicheren und zuverlässigen Betriebs.

• Verbessern von Maschinen und Anlagen zur Stärkung der Leistung und langfristigen Zuverlässigkeit.

• Leisten technischer Unterstützung bei Versuchen, damit Teams erfolgreiche Ergebnisse erzielen.

• Fertigen und Anpassen von Präzisionsteilen aus Edelstahl, Metall und Kunststoff zur Erfüllung betrieblicher Anforderungen.

• Prüfen von Maschinen nach Bedarf, um Funktionalität, Sicherheit und Einsatzbereitschaft zu bestätigen.

• Unterstützen der Standortdienste und technischen Bereitschaftseinsätze, damit kritische Aktivitäten reibungslos weiterlaufen.

Damit überzeugst du uns

• Du bringst fundierte praktischer Kenntnisse in der mechanischen Instandhaltung und Anlagenoptimierung mit, einschliesslich computergesteuerter Werkzeugmaschinen.

• Du wendest Fachwissen in der Fertigung und Anpassung von Edelstahlkomponenten und weiteren Präzisionsteilen erfolgreich an.

• Du setzt ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit und eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise ein, um technische Prioritäten wirksam zu steuern.

• Eine konstruktive Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen mit ausgeprägtem Sicherheitsbewusstsein.

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Arbeitskenntnissen der Englischen Sprach.

• Du zeigst Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Schnelligkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, setzt Ideen in Massnahmen mit messbaren Auswirkungen um und kreierst gemeinsamen Mehrwert.

Das erwartet dich in unserem Bewerbungsprozess

Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven und respektvollen Bewerbungsprozess ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Anpassungen bereit. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur getragen, mit modernen Anlagen und Verfahren, die ein sicheres Umfeld für alle gewährleisten.

Der Bewerbungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Gespräch mit Talent Acquisition, ein Gespräch mit dem einstellenden Team sowie ein abschliessendes Gespräch und ein Angebot. Wir prüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingehen, und schliessen die Stelle, sobald eine gute Auswahl relevanter Kandidat:innen gefunden wurde. Deshalb empfehlen wir dir, dich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleib wachsam: Nestlé kontaktiert Kandidat:innen ausschliesslich über offizielle Unternehmens-E-Mail-Adressen und verlangt zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Bewerbungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen.

Bereit, Gutes zu bewirken?

Bewirb dich jetzt und beschleunige den Wandel, der das Leben und den Planeten verbessert.

Tipo di contratto / Durata: Perpetuo

Essere una forza per il bene e aiutare a nutrire una generazione più sana

Come polimeccanico: in EFZ a Nestlé Nutrition & Health, la vostra missione è quella di mantenere e migliorare le strutture meccaniche e le infrastrutture nel nostro centro di ricerca e sviluppo a Konolfingen. Si ottiene qualcosa lavorando a stretto contatto con colleghi di ingegneria, team tecnici e partner di produzione. Questa è la vostra opportunità per espandere la vostra esperienza e ottenere risultati significativi che migliorano la vita attraverso le innovazioni nutrizionali in tutto il mondo.

È così che si agisce come un polimeccanico: in EFZ qualcosa

• Manutenzione di attrezzature meccaniche e infrastrutture per supportare il funzionamento sicuro e affidabile.

• Migliorare le macchine e le attrezzature per migliorare le prestazioni e l'affidabilità a lungo termine.

• Fornire supporto tecnico nelle prove per aiutare i team a raggiungere risultati di successo.

• Fabbricazione e adattamento di parti di precisione in acciaio inox, metallo e plastica per soddisfare le esigenze operative.

• Macchine di prova necessarie per confermare funzionalità, sicurezza e disponibilità operativa.

• Supporta servizi di localizzazione e standby tecnico per garantire che le attività critiche continuino senza intoppi.

Questo ci convincerà

• Si porterà un'approfondita conoscenza pratica nella manutenzione meccanica e ottimizzazione degli impianti, compresi gli strumenti di macchina controllati dal computer.

• È possibile applicare con successo le competenze nella produzione e adattamento dei componenti in acciaio inossidabile e di altre parti di precisione.

• Userete una forte capacità organizzativa e un ambiente di lavoro autonomo per gestire efficacemente le priorità tecniche.

• Una cooperazione costruttiva con i colleghi: donne con una forte consapevolezza della sicurezza.

• Conoscenza fluida della lingua inglese e della buona conoscenza del lavoro tedesco.

• Si mostra coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, tradurre idee in misure con effetti misurabili e creare valore aggiunto condiviso.

Questo vi aspetta nel nostro processo di applicazione

Ci impegniamo a un processo di applicazione inclusivo e rispettoso e provvederemo volentieri ad adattamenti adeguati, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con strutture e procedure moderne che garantiscono un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di applicazione di solito include un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e un'intervista finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande non appena vengono ricevute e chiudiamo la posizione non appena è stata trovata una buona selezione di candidati rilevanti. Pertanto, si consiglia di applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate come riservate.

Restare vigili: Nestlé contatta i candidati esclusivamente attraverso gli indirizzi e-mail aziendali ufficiali e non richiede pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di applicazione.

Pronti a fare bene?

Applicare ora e accelerare il cambiamento che migliora la vita e il pianeta.

Ready to do good?

Apply now and accelerate the change that improves life and the planet.

jobs.description:
Strategic Research Operations

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Lab Data Technology Specialist at Nestlé Research within our Computational Sciences department, you will be responsible for reinforcing our laboratory data foundations to help unlock the full value of the data generated by our scientific instruments and laboratory systems. Sitting at the intersection of science, laboratory data, and modern data engineering, you will leverage latest data technologies and AI for coding tools to transform raw, heterogeneous scientific data into trusted, well-documented, and reusable data assets that accelerate impactful scientific research.

How you’ll make an impact as a Lab Data Technology Specialist

• Partner with laboratory stakeholders. data domain owners, lab business analysts together with data architects and engineers to translate functional requirements into scalable, and well-documented technical solutions, ensuring alignment between scientific workflows and technological capabilities

• Enable new and existing laboratory instruments end to end, from understanding the scientific workflow and data outputs to defining and establishing connectivity and data flow (LIMS, robotics, automation platforms, downstream systems), in collaboration with IT network, security specialists

• Collaborate with internal and external professionals to propose and implement customizations to lab digital platforms used (LIMS, instrument integration, technology specific data processing, metadata capture) in view of efficiency, quality, traceability, and governance by design

• Identify opportunities to increase value of lab data gathered across different sources by leveraging data technologies (data integrations, data warehousing, automated data quality checks, etc)

• Support testing, deployment, change management, and continuous improvement of compliant, scalable lab solutions, including AI-enabled opportunities to strengthen data flows and unlock value from lab data

What will make you successful

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or computational discipline (e.g., Chemistry, life sciences, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Data Engineering, Computer Science), or equivalent experience.

• Solid experience in applying data engineering to scientific, laboratory data

• Required technical skills

•

• LIMS customization, data models, and integration.

• Integrating lab instruments, applications, robots, and IoT with reference databases and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).

• Solid grasp of the lab solutions ecosystem: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, IoT-connected equipment, barcode systems, etc.

• Programming (e.g., Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Data engineering and modeling — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), APIs, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — with engineering rigor (Git, CI/CD, testing, data quality, observability, reproducibility).

• Nice-to-have technical skills

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases on scientific data

• Domain exposure in chemistry, biology, food, or omics

• Reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leveraging Agentic AI to automate data engineering activities

• Required non-technical skills

• Strong problem-solving and hands-on mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience collaborating with external vendors and data professionals and driving delivery through others

• Ability to work in cross-functional and international teams

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

In qualità di Lab Data Technology Specialist presso Nestlé Research all'interno del nostro dipartimento di Scienze Computazionali, sarete responsabili di rafforzare le nostre basi di dati di laboratorio per aiutare a sbloccare il valore completo dei dati generati dai nostri strumenti scientifici e dai sistemi di laboratorio. Seduto all'incrocio tra scienza, dati di laboratorio e ingegneria dei dati moderni, si leverà le ultime tecnologie dei dati e AI per codificare strumenti per trasformare i dati scientifici grezzi, eterogenei in risorse di dati affidabili, ben documentate e riutilizzabili che accelerano la ricerca scientifica di impatto.

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Lab Data Technology Specialist at Nestlé Research within our Computational Sciences department, you will be responsible for reinforcing our laboratory data foundations to help unlock the full value of the data generated by our scientific instruments and laboratory systems. Sitting at the intersection of science, laboratory data, and modern data engineering, you will leverage latest data technologies and AI for coding tools to transform raw, heterogeneous scientific data into trusted, well-documented, and reusable data assets that accelerate impactful scientific research.

How you’ll make an impact as a Lab Data Technology Specialist

• Partner with laboratory stakeholders. data domain owners, lab business analysts together with data architects and engineers to translate functional requirements into scalable, and well-documented technical solutions, ensuring alignment between scientific workflows and technological capabilities

• Enable new and existing laboratory instruments end to end, from understanding the scientific workflow and data outputs to defining and establishing connectivity and data flow (LIMS, robotics, automation platforms, downstream systems), in collaboration with IT network, security specialists

• Collaborate with internal and external professionals to propose and implement customizations to lab digital platforms used (LIMS, instrument integration, technology specific data processing, metadata capture) in view of efficiency, quality, traceability, and governance by design

• Identify opportunities to increase value of lab data gathered across different sources by leveraging data technologies (data integrations, data warehousing, automated data quality checks, etc)

• Support testing, deployment, change management, and continuous improvement of compliant, scalable lab solutions, including AI-enabled opportunities to strengthen data flows and unlock value from lab data

What will make you successful

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or computational discipline (e.g., Chemistry, life sciences, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Data Engineering, Computer Science), or equivalent experience.

• Solid experience in applying data engineering to scientific, laboratory data

• Required technical skills

•

• LIMS customization, data models, and integration.

• Integrating lab instruments, applications, robots, and IoT with reference databases and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).

• Solid grasp of the lab solutions ecosystem: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, IoT-connected equipment, barcode systems, etc.

• Programming (e.g., Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Data engineering and modeling — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), APIs, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — with engineering rigor (Git, CI/CD, testing, data quality, observability, reproducibility).

• Nice-to-have technical skills

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases on scientific data

• Domain exposure in chemistry, biology, food, or omics

• Reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leveraging Agentic AI to automate data engineering activities

• Required non-technical skills

• Strong problem-solving and hands-on mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience collaborating with external vendors and data professionals and driving delivery through others

• Ability to work in cross-functional and international teams

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

Be a force for good and help nurture a healthier generation

As a Senior Manufacturing Specialist, your mission is to lead manufacturing support for innovation and renovation projects, providing technical and operational expertise that enables successful industrialization and sustainable factory performance. At our research and development center in Konolfingen, Switzerland, we develop science-proven nutrition products, processes and packaging, while providing technical support to Nestlé factories worldwide. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with research and development teams, businesses, markets, factories, suppliers and external partners. This is your opportunity to grow your expertise and help improve lives through nutrition innovation worldwide.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Manufacturing Specialist

• Leading manufacturing support across innovation and renovation projects to turn promising concepts into competitive products, processes and systems

• Driving early manufacturing input, risk assessment and technical decisions that improve readiness, speed and implementation quality

• Delivering reliable technical assistance during industrialization, start-ups and product launches to achieve efficient, sustainable factory performance

• Building and documenting specialist knowledge, standards and guidelines that strengthen manufacturing capability across sites

• Exploring breakthrough technologies and processes that create new opportunities for innovation, productivity and competitive advantage

• Developing factory knowledge through training, coaching and networks that accelerate learning and cross-site collaboration

What will make you successful

• Bringing deep manufacturing, engineering or product development expertise to industrialization and factory support

• Applying current quality, safety and hygiene standards to deliver robust and sustainable solutions

• Using data analysis, digital tools and structured problem solving to identify risks and improve performance

• Collaborating across functions, sites and cultures while communicating technical recommendations clearly to varied audiences

• Communicating fluently in English

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Essere una forza per il bene e aiutare a nutrire una generazione più sana

In qualità di Senior Manufacturing Specialist, la vostra missione è quella di guidare il supporto manifatturiero per progetti di innovazione e ristrutturazione, fornendo competenze tecniche e operative che consentono un'industrializzazione di successo e prestazioni di fabbrica sostenibili. Nel nostro centro di ricerca e sviluppo a Konolfingen, in Svizzera, sviluppiamo prodotti, processi e imballaggi per la nutrizione scientifica, fornendo supporto tecnico alle fabbriche Nestlé in tutto il mondo. Farete la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con team di ricerca e sviluppo, aziende, mercati, fabbriche, fornitori e partner esterni. Questa è la vostra opportunità per crescere la vostra esperienza e contribuire a migliorare la vita attraverso l'innovazione nutrizionale in tutto il mondo.

Come farete un impatto come Senior Manufacturing Specialist

• Leader del supporto manifatturiero nei progetti di innovazione e ristrutturazione per trasformare i concetti promettenti in prodotti, processi e sistemi competitivi

• Guidare l'ingresso di produzione precoce, la valutazione del rischio e le decisioni tecniche che migliorano la disponibilità, la velocità e la qualità di implementazione

• Fornire assistenza tecnica affidabile durante l'industrializzazione, start-up e lancio di prodotti per ottenere prestazioni di fabbrica efficienti e sostenibili

• Costruire e documentare conoscenze specialistiche, standard e linee guida che rafforzano la capacità produttiva in tutti i siti

• Esplorare tecnologie e processi innovativi che creano nuove opportunità per innovazione, produttività e vantaggio competitivo

• Sviluppare conoscenze di fabbrica attraverso formazione, coaching e reti che accelerano l'apprendimento e la collaborazione tra i siti

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare competenze di produzione, ingegneria o sviluppo di prodotti a supporto industriale e di fabbrica

• Applicare standard di qualità, sicurezza e igiene attuali per fornire soluzioni robuste e sostenibili

• Utilizzo di analisi dei dati, strumenti digitali e risoluzione dei problemi strutturati per identificare i rischi e migliorare le prestazioni

• Collaborare tra funzioni, siti e culture, comunicando con chiarezza raccomandazioni tecniche al pubblico vario

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo felici di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Pronto a essere una forza per il bene?

Applicare ora e accelerare il cambiamento che migliora le vite e il pianeta.

Fabrik Basel è una società di produzione ad alte prestazioni di Nestlé Suisse S.A. e produce prodotti culinari del marchio THOMY per la Germania e l'estero.
